incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: P1 - Prod inference routing errors observed (12 errors in last 5m). Affected customers: 2 (EU region). Please acknowledge and take ownership.
Alex P: Ack — I'm primary for this shift, looking now.
Samira K: I'm online (EU) and can step in as primary if needed, ETA ~10m.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0314-08. Severity P1. Paging eng-oncall.
Alex P: Quick signal check: dashboards show a spike in 502 responses from gateway->router cluster starting ~5:10 UTC. Any recent deploys or config changes? @Ravi N were you running the canary yesterday?
Ravi N: I was OOO overnight but left canary at 20%. No config pushes from me this morning. I'll pull router logs now.
Samira K: If we need a primary/secondary swap for the night, I can take primary. Drop the runbook link and I can follow steps.
Alex P: Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/inference-routing#502s — quick steps I’ll follow: 1) check nginx/upstream health 2) restart router pod(s) 3) scale up routers, 4) failover to model-variant-b if persistent. Starting step 1.
Alex P: ```
$ kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=router -o wide
router-1   CrashLoopBackOff   12m
router-2   Running           2d
router-3   Running           2d
```
Samira K: Router-1 in CrashLoopBackOff — that'll cause 502s under certain load patterns. I can restart router-1 and watch. If it fails to come up, we'll promote an extra replica.
Alex P: Do it. I'm notifying CS oncall (cc @cs-oncall) so they can prepare customer comms if impact grows.
Alex P: Customer impact summary: global API error rate ~0.4% but EU tenant 'LexiAI' seeing spikes up to 5% for inference calls. Triage ticket is INC-2026-0314-08.
oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff check — scheduled primary: Alex P until 02:00 UTC, secondary: Ravi N. Override requested by Samira K — please confirm.
Ravi N: I can be secondary if Samira takes primary. Confirmed.
Samira K: Confirmed, I'll take primary in ~5m and perform the restart: `kubectl -n prod delete pod router-1` then monitor. Will also scale replicas to 4 if it returns flaky.
incident-bot: Action update: restart executed on router-1 at 1738123605. Monitoring error rate.
incident-bot: Pager status: error rate dropping — now baseline ~0.1% across regions after restart. Monitoring window 10m.
Alex P: :thumbsup: Excellent. Samira, when you take over please post a short handoff note with state + next steps.
Samira K: Handoff note (took primary at 1738123800): actions performed — restarted router-1, observed healthy pods, increased replica count to 4 to absorb traffic; current status healthy, error rate back to baseline. Next steps: watch upstream latency (threshold >500ms for 3m triggers rollback), if degradation recurs open a bridge and escalate to infra/dedicated team.
Alex P: I'll update the incident doc and ping CS for customer follow-up. Thanks everyone — leaving Samira as primary and Ravi as secondary for the rest of the overnight window.
